title: Provide operation object with exactly one op member
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: {"op": "add"}
expected_result: The operation object is accepted as valid regarding the 'op' member requirement.

title: Provide operation object with zero op members
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
expected_result: The operation object is rejected for failing to have exactly one 'op' member.

title: Provide operation object with multiple op members
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: {"op": "add", "op": "replace"}
expected_result: The operation object is rejected for failing to have exactly one 'op' member.

title: Use a valid value
precondition: A system processing values according to section 4 is running
input: add
expected_result: The value is accepted as valid without error.

title: Use an invalid value
precondition: A system processing values according to section 4 is running
input: invalid_value
expected_result: The value is recognized as an error.

title: Verify operation object with exactly one path member is valid
precondition: An operation object is being defined
input: An operation object containing one "path" member
expected_result: The operation object is accepted as valid regarding the path requirement

title: Verify operation object with no path member is invalid
precondition: An operation object is being defined
input: An operation object containing zero "path" members
expected_result: The operation object is rejected as invalid

title: Verify operation object with multiple path members is invalid
precondition: An operation object is being defined
input: An operation object containing two "path" members
expected_result: The operation object is rejected as invalid

title: Operation completes ignoring undefined member
precondition: An operation is defined with specific members.
input: An object containing a member explicitly defined for the operation and an undefined member.
expected_result: The operation completes successfully as if the undefined member did not appear in the object.

title: Include value member in operation object
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: Operation object containing a 'value' member with content specifying the value to be added.
expected_result: The operation object is valid and contains the 'value' member.

title: Omit value member from operation object
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: Operation object without the 'value' member.
expected_result: The operation object is invalid because it lacks the mandatory 'value' member.

title: Access array with an index equal to the number of elements
precondition: An array has a specific number of elements.
input: Specify an index equal to the number of elements in the array.
expected_result: The index is accepted as valid without error.

title: Attempt to use an index greater than the number of elements
precondition: An array has a specific number of elements.
input: Specify an index greater than the number of elements in the array.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or fails due to the index exceeding the element count.

title: Include a valid from member with a JSON Pointer string
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: An operation object containing "from": "/pointer/location"
expected_result: The operation object is valid and contains the required "from" member referencing the source location.

title: Omit the mandatory from member
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: An operation object missing the "from" member
expected_result: The operation object is considered invalid due to the missing mandatory "from" member.

title: Prevent moving a location into one of its children
precondition: A location exists at "/a/b" and a child location exists at "/a/b/c".
input: Attempt to move the "from" location "/a/b" to the "path" location "/a/b/c".
expected_result: The operation is rejected because the "from" location is a proper prefix of the "path" location.

title: Allow moving a location to a non-prefix path
precondition: A location exists at "/a/b" and another location exists at "/c/d".
input: Attempt to move the "from" location "/a/b" to the "path" location "/c/d".
expected_result: The operation is allowed because the "from" location is not a proper prefix of the "path" location.

title: Include from member with a JSON Pointer string
precondition: An operation object is constructed for a target document.
input: Operation object containing "from": "/path/to/value"
expected_result: The operation object is accepted as valid regarding the "from" requirement.

title: Omit from member from the operation object
precondition: An operation object is constructed for a target document.
input: Operation object missing the "from" member
expected_result: The operation object is rejected as invalid because it lacks the mandatory "from" member.

title: Include value member in operation object
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: An operation object containing a "value" member.
expected_result: The operation object is valid and successfully conveys the value to be compared.

title: Omit value member from operation object
precondition: An operation object is being constructed.
input: An operation object lacking the "value" member.
expected_result: The operation is considered invalid because the "value" member is required.

title: Perform operation where target location equals the value value
precondition: An operation is initialized with a target location and a 'value' value.
input: Target location matches the 'value' value.
expected_result: The operation is considered successful.

title: Perform operation where target location does not equal the value value
precondition: An operation is initialized with a target location and a 'value' value.
input: Target location does not match the 'value' value.
expected_result: The operation is not considered successful.
